root.title: The last page earns it
root.note: Elizabeth, with no power and no debt left to collect, asks the man whose control cost a life to come along, and the reader believes both her question and his “No.” Controlling idea: control is not competence. When you treat future possibility as leverage, you eventually destroy your ability to choose, and other people pay for your convenience. The test: if a character says the theme out loud, it's failed.
